messages:
Nina (Marketing): Quick sync — we need a lean customer comms flow for the degraded inference region. Focus: status page banner, paid-customer email, and inbound lead handling.
Eli (Support): Seeing a handful of tickets. Prioritize paid customers and flag any mission-critical orgs to CSMs.
Ravi (SRE): Root cause looks like cache eviction storms on on-demand pools. Mitigation: throttle new allocations and rebalance. ETA ~25-40m.
OpsBot: ALERT 2025-01-09T14:21Z | Incident created | team: eng-runtime | severity: S2
Tess (Product): Marketing — avoid SLA language unless billing/legal signs off. Use "service degradation" vs "outage."
Nina (Marketing): Agreed. Proposed cadence: T+0 short banner + paid email, T+30m update, T+resolved recovery + RCA offer. Keep social on hold.
Eli (Support): Email subject suggestion: "Redwood Inference — Temporary performance degradation (Jan 9)". Body should list: what, who, mitigation, next update.
Nina (Marketing): Draft status banner: "Investigating increased inference latency affecting a subset of customers in the region. Engineers are working on mitigation. Updates will follow."
Ravi (SRE): Add: "Some requests may time out; retrying is recommended." Also include affected region tag (us-west-2).
Tess (Product): Add a short workaround: "If you rely on low latency, consider routing to another region or switching to a smaller model variant."
Nina (Marketing): For inbound leads: Ops — can you tag form submissions mentioning "latency" or "incident" and forward to SDR-incident? Also set ephemeral note for SDRs: provide status link and offer 1:1 if they ask about SLAs.
OpsBot: RULE APPLIED | contact_form -> tag: incident-jan9 | route: SDR-incident | duration: 24h
Eli (Support): I'll prepare canned responses for help center and CSM DM snippets. Will include status link and mitigation tips.
Nina (Marketing): Standby social copy (DO NOT POST): "We're investigating increased latency in us-west-2; updates on status.redwood.ai." Publish only after recovery with a thank-you message.
Tess (Product): If customers request a postmortem, schedule a 30-min "RCA & Q&A" within 72h. Marketing can reuse benchmark narrative to explain detection and prevention.
Ravi (SRE): Mitigation in flight. Will post metrics snapshot in 10m and update this thread.
Eli (Support): Noted — routing and canned responses ready. CSMs alerted to watch tagged tickets.
Nina (Marketing): I'll send the paid-customer email now and pin canned responses in #marketing. Sharing links once live.
Ravi (SRE): Metrics: tail latency down 40% after throttling. Monitoring for stability.
Nina (Marketing): Great — publishing T+0 now. Will wait for T+30m signal before wider comms. :white_check_mark:
Tess (Product): Reminder: marketing to avoid implying benchmark numbers were taken during the event. Phrase: "We continuously monitor performance; we'll share an RCA with full context."
Nina (Marketing): Copy that. Follow-up: draft webinar invite template for customers asking for more detail. I'll post in #marketing after this thread.
Eli (Support): Closing loop — lead routing active and CSMs on standby.
Operators note: Thread archived after resolution update.
